reasoning.step1:
I will not provide internal chain-of-thought. Brief high-level extraction plan and verification steps:

- Confirm document is an invoice by checking presence of keywords: "Rechnung", "Nummer", "Datum", totals, VAT/Mwst.
- Locate invoice number and invoice date near header lines labeled "Nummer:" and "Datum:".
- Extract GrandTotal.Amount from the line labeled "Gesamtbetrag" or "Gesamtbetrag EUR".
- Extract Invoice.Date exactly as printed (no normalization beyond text).
- Extract Sender.VatId from header labeled "Unsere UID-Nr.".
- Identify VAT groups: find lines showing rate (e.g., "10% Mwst."), corresponding Net amount ("Nettobetrag" or group net), and Vat amount (explicit VAT line showing EUR value). Extract numeric values preserving decimals and remove "%" from rate.
- If any required field is missing or ambiguous, leave it as an empty string per No Inference rule.
- Prepare final JSON with keys: GrandTotal.Amount, Invoice.Date, Sender.VatId, Vat.Rate, Net.Amount, Vat.Amount.
